description: This file defines the ReactAgentController class, a Flutter ChangeNotifier that manages state and interactions for a React Agent screen, connecting UI with underlying service logic.

classes.name: ReactAgentController
classes.description: A controller class managing the state and logic for the React Agent screen, including starting/stopping the agent, handling user input, and providing UI-related methods for step icons, colors, and titles.

methods.name: ReactAgentController
methods.description: Constructor that optionally takes an AgentService instance, sets up a listener for agent state changes.

methods.name: _onAgentChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the agent state changes; updates steps and running status.

methods.name: startAgent
methods.description: Starts the agent process if user input is provided; shows an error message if input is empty.

methods.name: clearSteps
methods.description: Resets the agent, clears steps, errors, and user input.

methods.name: setUserInput
methods.description: Sets the user input string and notifies listeners.

methods.name: getStepIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon representing the step type for UI display.

methods.name: getStepColor
methods.description: Returns a color associated with the step type for UI display.

methods.name: getStepTitle
methods.description: Returns a string title and emoji for the step type for UI display.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes the listener from the agent service and disposes of resources.
